fms_config_path.hint: Path to the freemodel-sync YAML config (targets, filters, providers). Empty = freemodel-sync's default ($FREEMODEL_SYNC_CONFIG or ~/.config/freemodel-sync/config.yml).

openrouter_api_key.hint: Passed only to the freemodel-sync subprocess as OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Leave empty to use the environment. Never shown in chat.

groq_api_key.hint: Passed only to the subprocess as GROQ_API_KEY. Only used when the groq provider is enabled in the freemodel-sync config. Never shown in chat.

auto_sync_enabled.hint: Run `freemodel-sync sync` on a timer. Can also be toggled with /fms auto on|off.

auto_sync_interval_minutes.hint: Minimum 30. Every sync spends a few free requests on probes.

auto_sync_notify.hint: Send a short, redacted result to the chat where /fms auto on was last run.

list_limit.description: Max models shown by /fms list and /fms rank
